channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula liga ao vivo para Flávio Dino, do STF, antes de sancionar lei no PA
item.description: President Lula makes a live video call to Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino during a federal event in Pará before signing a bill. The call was broadcast live, but Dino was not heard during the session.

item.title: Renan promete acionar Justiça se Globo não chamá-lo para debate sem Lula
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) threatens legal action against TV Globo if not invited to the presidential debate in case Lula does not participate. The broadcaster agreed that, in the event of an absent candidate, the replacement would be the one leading the polls. Renan leads over Romeu Zema and may join the debate.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao TSE cassação da chapa de Lula por abuso de poder
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the annulment of Lula's ticket for political and economic abuse of power, accusing the Ministry of Culture of using public resources to benefit the campaign. The lawsuit also seeks the disqualification of First Lady Janja, Minister Margareth Menezes, and other ministry officials. According to the candidate, there was misuse of public machinery during events and dissemination of electoral materials.

item.title: Nunes Marques alerta Fachin sobre risco de “captura institucional” do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, warned Minister Edson Fachin about the risk of 'institutional capture' of the court, requesting the STF to filter election-related petitions. The concern arises amid debates on transparency and TSE's independence.

item.title: Janja usa medalha de Nossa Senhora Aparecida após fake news sobre padroeira
item.description: First Lady Janja wore a medal of Nossa Senhora Aparecida during an event where President Lula signed a bill supporting women's football, amidfalse news claiming that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro would try to remove the title of patron saint from the Virgin. The misinformation, spread by left-wing profiles on social networks, reached nearly 1 million shares and was subject toa removal order from the TSE, later revoked by the STF. Despite confirming the news was false, Lula referenced the rumor in an interview with TV Band.

item.title: A medida sugerida por Nunes Marques a Fachin contra ‘esvaziamento’ do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, requested the president of the STF, Edson Fachin, to implement a filter for urgent petitions related to the elections, aiming to prevent jurisdictional overlap and safeguard equality among candidates.

item.title: Flávio pede cassação da chapa de Lula por abuso de poder
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested the TSE to annul Lula and Alckmin's ticket for alleged abuse of power, claiming the Ministry of Culture was used to support the campaign. The lawsuit also seeks ineligibility for Janja, Margareth Menezes and other ministry officials.

item.title: Projeto de lei apresentado pelo governo torna crime a exploração e a publicidade de bets
item.description: The federal government submitted a bill (PL 5477/26) making it a crime to exploit and advertise bets, fixed-odds betting lotteries, with sentences of 2 to 6 years in prison and fines. The measure complements MP 1194/26, which provisionally banned bets, and includes crimes such as operating, promoting, or financially facilitating bets, with increased penalties for online games, health data misuse, or age verification bypassing. The proposal does not apply to Loteca, keeping it allowed.

item.title: Lula pede presença de ex-ministro Celso Sabino no palco de ato no Pará
item.description: President Lula decided that former minister Celso Sabino will go on stage during the campaign rally in Belém, even though he is not part of the PT-backed slate in Pará. Sabino is running for Senate independently, and Lula personally endorsed his candidacy. His inclusion on stage follows pressure from the PT to have the ally participate in the event.

item.title: O que o brasileiro pensa sobre o fim das bets, segundo enquete do Senado Federal
item.description: The Brazilian Senate opened a public consultation regarding the federal government's ban on sports betting lots (bets), with over 283,000 people in favor and 74,000 against at the time of reporting. The measure aims to reduce social and economic harms linked to gambling, including family debt and mental health risks, particularly among youth. The poll remains active while the issue is under consideration by Congress.

item.title: O reforço de Soninha a Tebet após a desistência de Salles em São Paulo
item.description: Following Ricardo Salles' withdrawal, Soninha Francine endorsed Simone Tebet for the Senate, strengthening a centrist programmatic alliance. Tebet emphasized the alignment of proposals with the Cidadania candidate, supported since 2022.

item.title: Justiça concede liberdade a Wilker Leão sem fiança ou medidas cautelares
item.description: Federal Justice granted provisional release to federal deputy candidate Wilker Leão (Novo), arrested in flagrante for damaging University of Brasília property. The judge decided not to require bail or precautionary measures, finding no grounds for preventive detention. The case involved painting activity and threats during the incident at UnB.

item.title: Em meio à disputa acirrada para Senado, Soninha apoia Tebet, rival de chapa
item.description: Soninha Francine (Cidadania) endorsed Simone Tebet (PSB) in the São Paulo Senate race, recommending a second vote for senator. Despite being part of the PSDB-Cidadania federation supporting Tarcísio, Soninha emphasized convergences with Tebet and advocated for both seats to be held by women.

item.title: O destino do País vai às urnas
item.description: The article discusses the importance of the 2026 elections to determine the country's future, highlighting Roberto Amaral's role as a political analyst. It addresses central issues such as economy, security, and corruption, reflecting on Brazil's democratic challenges. The author emphasizes the need for a qualitative debate in the polls.

item.title: Dino avisa que ferramentas xandônicas são exclusivas, após Mendonça usar porteira aberta por Moraes
item.description: André Mendonça censored social media posts relying on TSE jurisprudence, but Flávio Dino challenged the use of Moraes-era tools, signaling that a parallel election court is already active to curb broad censorship powers. The episode highlights tension within the Supreme Court over balancing disinformation control and free speech.

item.title: Kassio fala para Fachin que há risco de “captura institucional” do TSE
item.description: TSE president minister Kassio Nunes Marques sent an official letter to minister Luiz Edson Fachin criticizing the use of STF monocratic decisions against the TSE, warning about institutional capture risk and interference in elections. The conflict arises after minister Flávio Dino's decision suspending liminar from André Mendonça regarding humorist Antônio Tabet's post. Kassio requests a filter in petition distribution to STF and advocates for specific resources like the Extraordinary Appeal to reform TSE decisions.

item.title: Lula mantém 55% de chance de vencer eleição, diz diretor da Eurasia Group
item.description: Eurasia Group keeps Lula with 55% chance of winning, but election trending toward tie. Supreme Court crisis and Flávio Bolsonaro's inexperience favor Lula. Recent factors include ban on bets, Desenrola 3.0, and fake news.

item.title: Lula tem 44% e Flávio, 38% no 2º turno no Pará, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows Lula with 44% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 38% in a potential 2nd round in Pará. In the 1st round scenario, Lula leads with 45%, followed by Flávio with 36%, while blank and null votes total 6%.

item.title: Kassio vê como "temerárias" decisões do STF que interferem nas eleições
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, sent an official letter to the president of the STF, Edson Fachin, criticizing individual decisions from the Court that interfere in elections, following a preliminary injunction by Minister Flávio Dino regarding posts about Our Lady of Aparecida. Kassio labeled as 'dreadful' actions that disrespect the Constitutional jurisdiction of Electoral Justice and requested a filter for urgent electoral petitions.

item.title: Lula tem 48,96% e Flávio, 24,97% no 1º turno na BA, diz pesquisa
item.description: An Instituto França poll for Bahia shows Lula leading with 48.96%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 24.97% in the first round. The survey interviewed 2,000 voters between September 23-26, 2026, with a 2.2-point margin of error and cost R$30,000.

item.title: Kassio Nunes Marques reclama de 'indevida sobreposição de competência' do STF sobre o TSE
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques criticizes the STF for overstepping jurisdiction and undermining electoral justice, citing the Antonio Tabet case. Minister Flávio Dino reinstated a post suspended by André Mendonça, prompting Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team to appeal to the STF. The conflict highlights institutional tensions regarding TSE autonomy.

item.title: MPE pede suspensão de perfil de funcionário da Secom por fake news
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Public Ministry requested the suspension of George Marques, a Secom employee, for encouraging the spread of fake news involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the alleged removal of Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint. The investigation indicates the content was shared on social media with the intent to misinform voters. The case underscores concerns about disinformation ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Pastores defendem Flávio e acusam Lula de promover guerra religiosa
item.description: Evangelical pastors defended Flávio Bolsonaro and accused Lula of promoting a religious war, rejecting rumors about the patronage of Aparecida. Cimeb claims that Lula and his supporters spread fake news to harm the PL candidacy.

item.title: Juristas avaliam que decisão de Dino sobre posts contra Flávio é grave e burla sorteio no STF
item.description: Legal experts criticize Flávio Dino's decision to restore a false post about Flávio Bolsonaro, accusing strategic manipulation of the STF's case distribution system. The ruling was made within an existing case without a new draw, potentially allowing parties to choose favorable judges. The case involves freedom of expression and elections, raising concerns about process contamination.

item.title: Tebet e Marina criticam desistência de Salles: “Rendeu-se ao Centrão”
item.description: Simone Tebet and Marina Silva criticized Ricardo Salles' decision to withdraw from the Senate race, accusing him of 'giving in to Centrão' after endorsing Tarcísio de Freitas' slate. The two candidates, backed by Lula, emphasized their coalition as the sole independent force to represent São Paulo in the Senate.

item.title: Governo vai à Justiça contra 17 bets e pede R$ 1 bilhão de indenização por danos morais coletivos por vício de apostadores
item.description: The federal government filed a $1 billion lawsuit against 17 online betting companies for collective moral damages and SUS expenses linked to gambling addiction. The AGU demands compensation and double reimbursement for bets placed by gambling addicts, while President Lula imposed the ban on betting sites and sent a bill to criminalize the sector. Industry associations filed a lawsuit at the STF to suspend the prohibition.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede cassação da chapa Lula-Alckmin e inelegibilidade de Janja
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit at the TSE requesting the annulment of the Lula-Alckmin ticket and the disqualification of Janja, alleging misuse of Ministry of Culture resources for campaign purposes. The suit also accuses the first lady and Minister Margareth Menezes of involvement in electoral activities through the 'Movement Culture with Lula' event.

item.title: Jerônimo Rodrigues e ACM Neto empatam no 1º turno na BA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A França Institute survey shows a technical tie between Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) and ACM Neto (União Brasil) in the Bahia gubernatorial race, with 39.49% and 36.44% respectively. The margin of error is 2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Ibovespa tem baixa de olho em Treasuries, petróleo e eleições nesta segunda-feira
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 0.26% to 182,900 points, affected by U.S. market pressures, rising oil prices, and electoral uncertainties. Banks led the losses, while the dollar rose to R$5.22 due to global dollar strength and Middle East tensions.

item.title: Malafaia e outros pastores saem em defesa de Flávio após polêmica com Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Evangelical leaders, including Silas Malafaia, defended Flávio Bolsonaro after false controversy about removing Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Patroness of Brazil, accusing Lula of exploiting the episode to create religious division. The cited proposal was not made by Flávio and has been archived since 2008, but the controversy intensified after the candidate's statements about Brazil belonging to the Lord Jesus Christ.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Esquerda se converte ao catolicismo para salvar Lula
item.description: STF minister Flávio Dino overturned an order by André Mendonca restricting publications about fake news involving Our Lady of Aparecida. The left adopts a strategy of conversion to Catholicism to attract conservative voters and protect Lula in the 2026 election. The issue reflects an ideological battle for the presidency.

item.title: Soninha recomenda voto em Simone Tebet para segunda vaga ao Senado por SP
item.description: Soninha Francine (Cidadania) recommended voting for Simone Tebet (PSB) for the second Senate seat in SP, reinforcing support since 2022. Tebet thanked her and emphasized female solidarity against Centrão divisions. The alliance was affected by Ricardo Salles (Novo) withdrawal in favor of Tarcísio.

item.title: Rockbridge Network: a rede obscura dos EUA que teria ligações com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Rockbridge Network, a US conservative network linked to the Republican Party and figures like Donald Trump and J.D. Vance, is suspected of having ties to candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The PT party requested the Brazilian Supreme Court to investigate possible illegal foreign funding of Flávio's campaign, based on unsubstantiated claims made by candidate Renan Santos. Founded in 2019 by Christopher Buskirk, the network aimed to mobilize disaffected donors to support disruptive Republican agendas.

item.title: Flávio pede que Fux derrube decisão de Dino sobre posts de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign requested Supreme Court Minister Luiz Fux to suspend Minister Flávio Dino's decision, which allowed the posting of a false news item about the candidate allegedly intending to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of her title as Brazil's patron saint.

item.title: Lula avança entre católicos, evangélicos e mulheres após fim das bets
item.description: A Quaest poll shows President Lula (PT) gained five percentage points among Catholic voters following the announcement of the end of betting operations in Brazil and the controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Our Lady of Aparecida. The growth also occurs among evangelicals and women, strategic segments for re-election.

item.title: Maioria não vê possibilidade de interferência estrangeira nas eleições de 2026, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that 51% of Brazilians believe foreign countries cannot interfere in the 2026 elections, while 41% think such influence is possible. The topic reflects concerns about electoral security and transparency.

item.title: Drible ao sistema do STF permite que ministros tomem decisões em processos sem sorteio de relator
item.description: Supreme Court justices use a procedural maneuver to rule on cases without being rapporteurs, bypassing the Internal Rules, causing tension with the Electoral Court. Recent cases involving Flávio Dino, Gilmar Mendes, and André Mendonça exemplify this workaround, where requests are embedded into ongoing cases to select a favorable judge.

item.title: Quando será o 5º dia útil em outubro?
item.description: The fifth business day of October 2026 will be Tuesday, October 6, considering the labor calendar and the national holiday on Sunday, October 4. Employers must deposit salaries by this date according to Brazilian labor law.

item.title: Governo monitora rede que divulga bets e derruba 506 sites
item.description: A federal government task force took down 506 websites suspected of irregular online betting offerings after the provisional measure banning sports betting in Brazil was issued. The Ministry of Justice and Public Security expanded digital monitoring of the betting market, in partnership with the Ministry of Finance. The Ciberlab identified betting advertisements on Meta, Google, and TikTok platforms, with ads offering bonuses and incentives for new registrations.

item.title: Desenrola Brasil 3.0: veja como funciona novo programa para renegociar dívidas
item.description: President Lula announced Desenrola Brasil 3.0, a program to buy personal debts with discounts exceeding 90%. Created by provisional decree, it may benefit up to 15 million debtors with debts under R$10,000, covering both local and federal budgets.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre desistência de Salles: ‘gesto de grandeza em nome de um projeto maior’
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas thanked Ricardo Salles for withdrawing his Senate candidacy, calling it a gesture of 'greatness' for a greater project. Salles’ exit was seen as a strategy to redirect votes to Derrite and Prado, strengthening the conservative wing against Marina Silva and Simone Tebet.

item.title: Tarcísio elogia Salles por desistir de candidatura ao Senado: "Grandeza"
item.description: Ricardo Salles withdrew his Senate candidacy in São Paulo to support Guilherme Derrite and André do Prado, a move praised by Tarcísio de Freitas as a gesture of 'greatness' to unite the right-wing front. The decision strengthens conservative candidates in the race for the two Senate seats, with Salles thanking the governor for remaining an 'anti-left fortress'. The latest Datafolha poll placed him fifth with 4% of voter intentions.

item.title: Proibição das bets bate recorde e supera crise entre Moraes e Mendonça nas redes
item.description: President Lula's ban on online betting generated the largest wave of social media reactions in the past 12 months, surpassing even the Supreme Court ministers Moraes and Mendonça crisis. Within 63 hours, 2.5 million posts and 40 million interactions were recorded, with 57% of posts opposing the measure but 52% of interactions supporting the ban.

item.title: As regiões do Rio que recebem atenção especial de Paes e Ruas
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Douglas Ruas (PL) focus their gubernatorial campaigns on the West Zone of Rio de Janeiro and the Baixada Fluminense, regions with a strong conservative electorate that supported Jair Bolsonaro in 2022. Paes emphasizes local alliances and public events, while Ruas targets Bolsonaro voters to expand his base and force a runoff. Both strategies aim to capture demographics that significantly backed Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Bispo critica clã Bolsonaro após Flávio acusar CNBB de divulgar fake news
item.description: Bishop Dom Vicente Ferreira criticized the Bolsonaro clan after Flávio Bolsonaro accused CNBB of spreading fake news regarding the alleged removal of Our Lady of Aparecida as patron saint. CNBB denied involvement in misinformation, while judicial authorities became involved in analyzing related posts. The incident reflects tensions between religious and political sectors during the election campaign.

item.title: Entidades vão ao STF para suspender MP de Lula que proíbe as bets
item.description: Industry entities filed a lawsuit at the STF to suspend the provisional measure banning online betting in Brazil, under the rapporteurship of Luiz Fux. While no decision is made, websites and apps must shut down by October 6th. The measure went into effect on September 25th and requires congressional approval within 120 days.

item.title: Flávio pede a Fux que suspenda decisão de Dino sobre fake news de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked Minister Luiz Fux to suspend Flávio Dino's decision overturning the TSE order to remove fake news posts about Nossa Senhora Aparecida. The request aims to protect campaign operations and challenges electoral censorship.

item.title: A realidade paralela do eleitor de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Despite being aware of Flávio Bolsonaro's conversations with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, his voters continue to support him, revealing a political base that tolerates questionable practices. Surveys show that over half of informed voters approve or justify the act of requesting money from Vorcaro, highlighting a parallel reality where the merit of the action is overlooked and denial followed by externalizing blame is part of an established political strategy.

item.title: A disputa Lula X Flávio no maior colégio do Nordeste a 5 dias da eleição, segundo pesquisa
item.description: A poll by Real Time Big Data shows Lula with 61% of voting intentions against 24% for Flávio Bolsonaro in Bahia, the largest electoral college in Northeast Brazil. The 37-point lead is maintained in the second round, with Lula reaching 64% and Flávio 28%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede a Fux suspensão de decisão de Dino que liberou publicações sobre Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested Minister Fux to suspend Flávio Dino's decision that allowed publications about Our Lady of Aparecida. The request was filed with the STF on September 28, 2026.
